hints.title: Sliding Probability Window
hints.text: Maintain a rolling sliding sum of previous probabilities within the card point window range.

hints.title: Termination Thresholds
hints.text: Cards are drawn only while current points are strictly less than k. Once score reaches k, no further cards are drawn.

hints.title: Sliding Window Maintenance
hints.text: Let dp[i] be the probability of score i. Maintain running window_sum of dp[i - maxPts .. i - 1] for indices less than k, dividing by maxPts to compute dp[i].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: 1D probability DP with O(1) sliding window sum maintenance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing window sum of size maxPts at each step takes O(N * maxPts) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D DP array of size N + 1 holds state probabilities.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain running sliding sum to update transitions in constant time.
